bewegenHinweis: Drag a node to a new location. Tap a node to edit it.
dasAktuelleLevelVerwerfenNicht: Discard the current level? Unsafed changes will be lost.
dasIstKeinPulselevelcode: This is not a valid Pulse level code
dasLevelIstZuKomplexZumPrfen: The level complexity is to high to evaluate.
dasLevelIstZuKomplexZumPrfenMitWeniger: The level is to complex to evaluate, try to remove nodes or timed nodes
dasSpielIstAuchOhneTonVollstndigSpielbar: You can play the entire game without sound
dazuHabeIchIn2SekundenNichtsPassendes: I couldn't find a puzzle within 2 seconds. Select less options, add more nodes or select a different difficulty
derLinkEnthltKeinLevel: The link does not contain a level.
derStartknotenDarfKeinSpiegelTorOder: The root node must not be a mirror, gateway, or timed node
derStartknotenKannDasNichtSein: That can't be the root node.
dieGrafikKonnteNichtGestartetWerdenBitte: The graphic could not be launched. Please enable WebGL in your browser.
dieseBeidenKnotenLassenSichNichtZuEinem: These two nodes cannot be made into a mirror pair (excluding the start node).
dieseFarbeIstAufDemDunklenHintergrundZu: This color is too hard to see against the dark background.
diesesLevelIstNichtLsbarPrfe: This level cannot be solved. Check for one-way edges, gates, single use nodes, and time limits.
duKannstHchstens50LevelSpeichernLsche: You can save up to 50 levels. Delete one first.
einLevelHat1BisMaxNodesKnoten: A level can have between 1 and {{MAX_NODES}} nodes
einmalknotenOhneZusatzErwartet: A single use node without any additions is expected
ersetztDasAktuelleLevelMitRckgngigHolst: This replaces the current level; use “Undo” to revert it. You can then edit the result just like any other.
fortschrittWirklichZurcksetzen: Do you want to reset your progress?
imSpielErkennstDuFarbknotenUndToreAn: In the game, you can identify color nodes and gates by their shape: triangles and diamonds represent the two colors, while the circle represents the neutral impulse. So the color is never the only clue.
kanteHinweis: Tap two nodes in succession. Each subsequent tap on the same pair switches the behavior: both ways, only one way, only the other way, or neither.
kanteVerweistAufEinenUnbekanntenKnoten: The edge points to an unknown node.
kanteVerweistAufUnbekanntenKnotenFrom: The edge points to an unknown node: {{from}}
kanteVerweistAufUnbekanntenKnotenTo: The edge points to an unknown node: {{to}}
knotenHinweis: Tap an empty field to place a node. Tap a node to edit it.
knotenIdIstVomStartAusNieErreichbar: node {{id}} can't be reached from the start
kopierenWarNichtMglichMarkiereDenLink: Copying wasn't possible. Select the link below and copy it manually.
leiteDenImpulsDurchDasNetzUndAktiviere: Send the pulse through the network and activate each node.
lschenHinweis: Tap a node or an edge to delete it.
mehrAlsMaxNodesKnotenSindNichtMglich: More than {{MAX_NODES}} nodes are not allowed.
spiegelknotenIdBrauchtEinenZwillingDer: The mirror node {{id}} needs a twin that points back to it
tippeDenZwillingVonKnotenPairFromAnOder: Tap the twin of node {{pairFrom}} (or tap the screen to cancel).
tippeJetztDenZwillingVonKnotenIdAn: Now tap the twin of node {{id}}.
weitereLevelMitTimerUndSpiegelknoten: Additional levels featuring timed and mirror nodes will be included in the full version.
zeitknotenIdBrauchtEinGanzzahligesLimit: Timed node {{id}} requires a number limit starting at 1
zumAufnehmenInDieKampagneAls: To include in the campaign: save as <1>src/levels/level-NN.json</1>, set the ID, and add it to <3>levels.ts</3>.
zumTestenUndTeilenMussDasLevelFehlerfrei: To be eligible for testing and sharing, the level must be free of errors, solvable, and have at least 3 nodes.
zwillingeFromUndToDrfenKeineKanteTeilen: Twins {{from}} and {{to}} must not share an edge
zwillingKnotenPairZumNdernSpiegelErneut: Twin: Node {{pair}}. To change it, select “Mirror” again.
stuckText: Dead end. Undo your last move or start over.
unsolvableText: From here on, the level can't be solved. Undo your last move.
pianoDesc: Notes that have been struck and are fading away
drumsDesc: Each node is a drum sound; the path becomes a rhythm
